description: teleport CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs the depends_on closure (identity_core, the vocabulary dependency behind teleport_user's HELD_BY_HUMAN__identity_core declaration, from git at a pinned commit) and teleport; the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds teleport's own bundle (the /teleport page). Installation fetches the two pinned git sources; nothing after installation reaches the network, and no credential is used. Deliberately excluded: every plugin outside the depends_on closure.

plugins.note: Vocabulary dependency, pinned at the full commit of the v0.1.3 tag (this plugin's depends_on floor), the first release carrying identity_core__human and HELD_BY_HUMAN__identity_core. Offline and credential-free.

Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins teleport`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).

steps.note: teleport's own bundle: the /teleport page, its graph panel, projection, layout, scene searches and board panels.
